# Korean Market Analysis (2026-08-13)
**Market Position & Sentiment:** KOSPI trades at 6,813.34 [market-analysis:^KS11], supported by positive regional momentum as US equities rallied to SPX 7,791.2 [market-analysis:^GSPC] on benign inflation data [news cluster: Asian Stocks]. Fear & Greed index at 66 [market-analysis:fear-greed] signals moderate optimism.
**Macro Tailwinds:** CPI cooled to 3.3% [market-analysis:macro.cpi], reducing Fed rate hike expectations despite rates holding at 3.63% [market-analysis:macro.fed-rate]. However, NFP contracted -23k [market-analysis:macro.nfp-mom], signaling labor market softening that supports risk appetite.
**Technical Environment:** VIX at 14.67 [market-analysis:^VIX] indicates low volatility; 10Y yields at 4.645% [market-analysis:^TNX] offer stable risk-free rates. DXY near parity at 99.97 [market-analysis:DX-Y.NYB] supports EM currencies including KRW.
**Commodity Headwinds:** WTI $81.84/barrel [market-analysis:CL=F] and Gold $4,413.3/oz [market-analysis:GC=F] reflect geopolitical tensions (Houthi attacks in Red Sea) [news cluster: Red Sea] offsetting inflation relief, creating mixed signals for Korean exporters and inflation-sensitive sectors.
